第33章 彩礼钱？一分不退-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

石溪村的百姓目光朝着王乃香住的地方望了过去，在见到王乃香居住的环境后，一个个眉头紧皱，脸上流露出一抹叹息之色。

村头的这几间稻草搭建的房子，大家都是知道的。

当时是为了防范胡子，临时的岗哨，除了这处明岗之外，当然还有几处暗岗，两个大一些的草房子是住人的，另外一个小的一些的茅草房子是狗窝，住狗的。

这老两口，竟然让王乃香一个柔弱女子去住狗窝？

确实畜生了一些。

正常也应该是赵贵和赵强住在一起，赵贵婆娘和自己儿媳妇住在一起才是。

如此看来，这老两口，真不是个东西啊。

刚刚被打也是活该。

“这儿媳妇可是我们家花了彩礼娶回来的，要是想要分户也不是不行，得将彩礼还给我们家，当时我们家可是给了二十斤大米，还有三十个鸡蛋，这些鸡蛋要是孵成小鸡的话，那可就是三十个小鸡，小鸡长大了又是大鸡，再生蛋……！”

“这么多年下来算一算！”

“至少，至少要给我们家五十块钱才行！”

赵贵狮子大开口，伸出了五根手指道。

五十块钱？

赵贵一开口，石溪村的百姓无不暗自吸了一口气。

乖乖。

这赵贵还真是敢要啊，五十块钱能买一套院子了，而且这年月，谁家能拿的出五十块钱啊！！

“五十块钱？”

“一分钱都不会给！”

“今天，老子就带王乃香走了，这户口你们爱分不分，但是要是让我再看到你们敢欺负王乃香，就别怪老子不客气。”

“大不了，咱们就去找政府。”

“村长，你是村子里的干部，也经常去乡里开会，肯定知道乡里的意思，什么叫做婚姻自由，什么叫做保障妇女权益！”

“我要是带着王乃香去乡里找了妇联干部处理这件事情，妇联干部非要把你们老两口全都抓起来关大牢里面去。”

李青山冷哼一声，开口吓唬道。

村子里一般都会有妇女主任，乡里面的则是妇联干部，或者妇联主任。

听到关大狱。

赵贵一家子顿时脖子一缩，目光朝着村长望了过去道：“村长，这是真的吗？怎么还能把我们老两口关大狱呢，这不是我们家自己的事情吗？”

The people in Shixi Village looked towards where Wang Naixiang lived. After seeing the environment where Wang Naixiang lived, they all frowned and sighed.

Everyone knows these houses made of straw at the end of the village.

At that time, it was to prevent beards, a temporary sentry post. In addition to this open post, there were of course several hidden posts. Two larger thatched houses were for people to live in, and the other smaller thatched house was a kennel for dogs.

This old couple actually let a weak woman like Wang Naixiang live in a doghouse?

It's really a bit savage.

Normally, Zhao Gui and Zhao Qiang should live together, and Zhao Gui's wife and her daughter-in-law should live together.

From this point of view, this old couple is really not the same thing.

He deserved the beating just now.

"The daughter-in-law here was brought back by our family with a betrothal gift. If we want to divide the household, we have to return the betrothal gift to our family. At that time, our family gave us twenty kilograms of rice and thirty eggs. If these eggs hatch into chicks, there will be thirty chicks. When the chicks grow up, they will become big chickens and lay eggs...!"

"Let's do the math after all these years!"

"At least, at least give our family fifty yuan!"

The lion Zhao Gui opened his mouth and stretched out five fingers.

Fifty dollars?

As soon as Zhao Gui spoke, the people in Shixi Village secretly took a breath.

Be good.

This Zhao Gui really dares to ask for it. Fifty yuan can buy a yard, and in these days, who can afford fifty yuan!!

"Fifty dollars?"

"I won't give you a penny!"

"Today, I will take Wang Naixiang away. You all have different accounts, but if I see you dare to bully Wang Naixiang again, don't blame me for being rude."

"In the worst case, we'll go to the government."

"Village chief, you are a cadre in the village and you often go to the village for meetings. You must know what the village means, what freedom of marriage means, and what it means to protect women's rights!"

"If I take Wang Naixiang to the countryside and find the Women's Federation cadres to handle this matter, the Women's Federation cadres will arrest you two and put you in jail."

Li Qingshan snorted coldly and started to threaten.

There are usually women directors in villages, while those in townships are Women's Federation cadres or Women's Federation directors.

I heard that he was imprisoned in prison.

Zhao Gui's family suddenly shrank their necks, looked at the village chief and said, "Village Chief, is this true? How can they put us old couple in jail? Isn't this our family's own business?"
